Situation.description: A culturally authentic celebration of Tamil traditions, agriculture, family, cattle and harvest.

Composition.arrangement: Natural composition with people and traditional elements throughout the village environment

Esthetics.clothing: Traditional Tamil cotton sarees, veshti, angavastram and pavadai

images.title: Traditional Thai Pongal Celebration
images.prompt: A culturally authentic Tamil Nadu Thai Pongal celebration in a beautiful rural village during the 1990s. A traditional Tamil family gathers around a decorated clay pot cooking sweet Pongal over a wood fire. Milk overflowing from the pot, women wearing colorful traditional cotton sarees, men wearing white veshti and angavastram, children smiling and shouting Pongalo Pongal. Fresh sugarcane stalks, turmeric plants, banana leaves, brass vessels, colorful rice flour kolam and mango leaf decorations. Traditional red tiled-roof village houses and coconut trees in the background. Warm golden sunrise, joyful expressions, realistic Tamil cultural details, cinematic photorealism.

images.title: Traditional Mattu Pongal Celebration
images.prompt: An authentic traditional Mattu Pongal celebration in a Tamil Nadu village during the 1980s and 1990s. Beautiful native Tamil cattle including Kangayam bulls and cows decorated with colorful flower garlands, painted horns and traditional bells. Farmers and their families joyfully celebrating and showing gratitude to their cattle. Children happily standing beside decorated cows, villagers wearing traditional veshti and cotton sarees. Traditional village houses, coconut trees, sugarcane decorations and green agricultural fields in the background. Peaceful rural atmosphere, warm sunlight, natural expressions, culturally accurate Tamil agricultural traditions, cinematic photorealistic photography.
images.emotion: Gratitude, happiness and respect for cattle

images.title: Traditional Tamil Village Cultural Festival
images.prompt: A grand culturally authentic Tamil village festival celebration during the 1990s. A lively village street filled with traditional Tamil folk performances including Karagattam, Kolattam and Thappattam. Men playing traditional Parai drums, women performing colorful folk dances, children celebrating and elders watching happily. Traditional Tamil costumes, colorful pavadai, davani, cotton sarees, veshti and jasmine flowers. Beautiful kolam designs outside traditional tiled-roof houses, sugarcane decorations, banana trees, mango leaf thoranam and festive village decorations. Bright natural daylight, joyful smiling faces, energetic movements, rich Tamil cultural heritage, realistic village environment, cinematic photorealistic photography.

final_output.theme_consistency: All three images must maintain the same nostalgic Tamil village atmosphere
final_output.visual_goal: Show the beauty, happiness and cultural authenticity of Tamil Nadu Pongal celebrations
